bugs.error_message: Production: GET/POST /api/deck-submission returns 413 FUNCTION_PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE on oip.ntt-startupchallenge.com when uploading pitch decks; user reported files were 'already under 8 MB' and was submitting 2 decks at once. Client showed 'Submission failed. Please try again.'
bugs.root_cause: Vercel serverless Functions cap the WHOLE incoming request body at 4.5 MB (platform limit, not configurable per-route). The deck form bundled ALL selected files into ONE multipart POST, and both client+server validated only 8 MB PER FILE. So 2 decks of ~4 MB each (=8 MB combined) or a single 4.5-8 MB deck exceeded 4.5 MB and Vercel rejected the request with a non-JSON 413 BEFORE the handler ran — the server's own 8 MB check never executed. Same platform limit as bug-107 (registration PDF), but deck limit was intentionally left at 8 MB (cerebrum), so it surfaced later in production.
bugs.fix: Bypassed the serverless body limit with Vercel Blob CLIENT uploads (browser->Blob direct, not through the Function). (1) New app/api/deck-blob/route.ts mints a scoped, size-capped (maximumSizeInBytes=8MB) upload token via handleUpload/onBeforeGenerateToken after verifying the email has a registration. (2) deck-submission-form.tsx now upload()s each file to Blob (multipart:true) then POSTs {email, uploads:[{field,url,name}]} as small JSON. (3) app/api/deck-submission/route.ts POST switched from formData() to JSON: validates each url host ends '.public.blob.vercel-storage.com' (SSRF guard), fetch()es each blob (a response body, not subject to the 4.5MB request cap), streams into the existing PocketBase PATCH, then del()s the staged blobs; added export const maxDuration=60. Storage stays in PocketBase (dashboard/download unchanged), superuser token stays server-side. REQUIRES a Vercel Blob store linked to the project (env BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN) + redeploy. Verified: tsc clean, 48 tests pass, next build registers /api/deck-blob + /api/deck-submission.

Added an explicit BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN presence check that returns a clear 500 instead of the vague 'Failed to retrieve the client token'. Also migrated the fast-track (registration-lite) flow to the same Blob-staging pattern: new /api/fast-track-blob token route (no registration check, since fast-track creates a NEW record), fast-track-form now uploads to Blob then POSTs {email,problems,uploads} JSON, and /api/fast-track fetches each blob, creates the PB record, then del()s.
